name: task-progress
description: Shows a progress bar, percentage and estimated time left for every task above the prompt.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto=follow Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale (English if neither is recognized); en=English; zh-TW=繁體中文

barStyle.title: Progress bar style
barStyle.description: auto=candy in the desktop app, solid in the terminal; solid=solid blocks; blocks=█░; dots=●○; line=━─; segments=▰▱; ascii=[##--]; desktop-only SVG: candy=glossy rounded with icon, stripes=striped capsule, glossy=segmented gradient, neon=glowing tube (the terminal falls back to a character style; character styles are drawn as a plain SVG bar in the desktop app)

iconSet.title: Icon set
iconSet.description: symbols=✓●○; emoji=✅🔄⏳; circles=●◐○; minimal=+>-; none=no icons

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: detailed=one row per task; compact=single-line summary; header=overall progress only

showWorking.title: Show the "Working" row
showWorking.description: on=show a Working row with elapsed seconds while Claude is busy; off=tasks only

spinnerProgress.title: Add task progress to the spinner
spinnerProgress.description: on=append task progress after spinner lines such as Unfurling…; off=leave the spinner as is
